comingLast.roast: a 7-handicapper last in - the honour board is looking the other way
he can still pass Widdison - stranger things have happened, rarely to him
3 holes for a jailbreak - 7 points cuts the wire
6 holes to dodge the double blue - the field is glued to his group
9 points from escape - Widdison has stopped watching his own card
needs 8 points from his last 5 to hand the blue balls to Widdison
at 1.2 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
4 from his last 3 - grandstand finish at the wrong end
still out there on 19 - the clubhouse is doing his maths for him
the blue balls are patient - 5 holes is nothing to them
